note: The corpus behind J2 (search) and the search/labels/embedding checks. Fictional people and domains. Record 1 is the Linea Supply quote thread (msg-01, acc-04, 0.84 EUR, quote-Q1-print-run.pdf). The design fixture (docs/design/fixtures/mac-main-sample.json) dates msg-01 'Today 09:12' and carries no body, thread or date fields; J2's trigger says 'last spring' and J2.2 filters 'before June', so this file re-dates record 1 and adds the decoys each filter and each exact-figure check needs to be able to fail. No number of the ledger lives here: sizes and budgets come from docs/CONSTANTS.md.

expect.mac_note: SPEC A141 to A143 on the Mac: the list is every mail, the exact matches first, then ONE divider and the close ones; the count line says N matches then M close in meaning. result_sections and filter_text stay for the phone's check and the rule editor's check (checks/searchphone-check.py, checks/labelscontactsmac-check.py); the Mac checks read these mac_ keys. SPEC A150 (2026-11-11) replaced the close group: the list is the matches, then the line Related and the related mail, then the closed line All other mail; the count line says N matches then M related; mac_divider_keys ranked is Related (journeys/J2.py divider_follows_stage, header_counts). mac_result_sections and mac_count_keys are read by no check (grep of journeys and checks, lane hid-search).
expect.not_downloaded_note: not indexed yet, download to search inside

filter_cases.why: the word from in a sentence stays a word: a sender filter is from:name or Tab on Sender contains (SPEC A142)

filter_cases.text: price from:"Linea Supply" before June has attachment

filter_cases.why: the same filter twice is one chip, not two
a filter word not understood stays as plain words and the bar says so
a filter word with no value is plain text
'has' is part of the filter; the bare noun is a word to search

typed_cases.why: the colon form is a pill (SPEC A142, A143)
the word from in a sentence stays a word: the owner's picture, a pill 'From c' (SPEC A142)
typed words make no pill; the dropdown offers the person and Has attachment, Tab makes them
a date in words is offered by the dropdown and made a pill by Tab, never by the typing alone
a day in the colon form is a pill
To is a pill kind of its own (SPEC A143)
the same filter twice is one pill, not two
a colon form whose value is not a day stays words
a filter word with no value is plain text
